description: Upload a local audio/video file and wait until transcription finishes. Prefer for short/medium clips when you need the transcript in this turn. Pass an absolute filesystem path (never raw binary). Set task='translate' to get an English translation instead of a same-language transcript. Pass output_file (absolute path) to save the transcript to disk instead of returning it, which keeps long transcripts out of context. On wait timeout, returns job_id, then call get_job_status. For long audio you plan to poll yourself, use start_job_file instead.

language.description: Optional two-letter ISO language code (e.g. en, es).

model.description: Transcription model tier. core = default balance of speed/accuracy, max = hardest audio.

output_file.description: Optional absolute path ending in .txt, .md, .json, .srt, or .vtt, outside hidden folders. When the transcript is ready it is written to this file instead of being returned in the tool result, which keeps long transcripts out of the conversation context. The parent folder must exist. An existing file is not overwritten unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Set true to let output_file replace an existing file. Default false.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to an audio or video file. Relative paths are rejected. Do not pass raw binary over MCP.

prompt.description: Custom vocabulary hint: proper nouns, acronyms, or product names to spell correctly (e.g. 'SpeechWeave, Acme Corp'). Only reliably influences the first ~30s of audio, not a full glossary.

response_format.description: Optional transcript format. Omit for the default plain transcript. 'srt'/'vtt' return subtitle-file text; 'verbose_json' includes timestamped segments.

service_mode.description: Service mode. standard = default speed and price. deferred = lower cost, lower priority.

task.description: transcribe (default) keeps the audio's original language. translate produces an English translation instead, the language param is ignored when translating.

timeout_ms.description: Max milliseconds to wait for completion (default 1 hour). On timeout, returns job_id so you can call get_job_status.

name: transcribe_file
title: Transcribe local file (sync)
